what: TSMC (Taiwan) is the world's largest contract chipmaker: it manufactures the chips that companies such as Apple and NVIDIA design, in the most advanced factories in the industry.
customers: Apple, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, Broadcom, MediaTek and hundreds of other chip designers.
money: processors for iPhones and Android phones
chips for cars and connected devices
moat: Years ahead of rivals in leading-edge processes (3 and 2 nanometer), huge scale, and customers' trust because it never competes with them.
risks: Geopolitical risk between Taiwan and China
Concentration on a few large customers such as Apple and NVIDIA
High cost of new fabs in the US and Japan
